## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (pytest and all prek hooks).
- [ ] Tests cover the new or changed behaviour (tests first for bug fixes).
- [ ] `make docs` passes, if the public API or `docs/` changed.
- [ ] `make notebooks` was run and outputs are committed, if `examples/*.ipynb` changed.
- [ ] I added an entry to `docs/release_notes.rst`, if the change is user-facing.
- [ ] Ready for review (no drafts, no WIP).
